blocks.text: Debt is a tool. Like a knife, it can cut your food or cut your hand.
Debt that puts money IN your pocket later.

items: Education Loan: Increases your salary potential.
Home Loan (Rental): Tenant pays the EMI.

blocks.text: Debt that takes money OUT for things that lose value.

items: Credit Card EMI: Paying 18% interest on Pizza.
Personal Loan: Funding a wedding to impress others.

blocks.text: 🧮 See your own debt payoff plan in the Debt Optimizer →

summary: Good debt builds wealth, bad debt drains it — the line between leverage and chains, in two minutes.
title: Good vs Bad Debt
